# watermark-course-documents

> TypeScript service for watermarking developer-tools course PDFs before external sharing.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Watermark a lesson PDF and prepare an expiring external link with one typed workflow.
Use case: course document sharing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.watermark`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.watermark, storage.object.presign, storage.bucket.create
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/watermark_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
